Known facts about the problem are loaded.

3. Selecting the Search Strategy
The system chooses a method for exploring the state space, such as:
Depth-First Search (DFS)

4. Matching Rules
The inference engine compares the conditions of the rules with existing facts.

5. Conflict Resolution
If multiple rules can be applied:
One is chosen based on a prioritization strategy (e.g., specificity, recency, importance).

6. Applying the Rule (Inference)
The selected rule is executed.

7. Checking the Stopping Condition
The system checks if:
The final state (solution) has been reached,
No more applicable rules exist,
Or a time/resource limit has been exceeded.

8. Explaining the Decision (Optional but Important)
The system can generate an explanation of the decision:
Which rules were applied,
What facts led to the conclusion.
